svg.title: 05 | Post-OOS observations: spread and price follow-through

cc:Work.dc:title: 05 | Post-OOS observations: spread and price follow-through
cc:Work.dc:description: Post-OOS descriptive diagnostics only, conditional on actually executed trades. The spread wedge is an accounting identity. Won given +0.5R uses only trades that reached +0.5R. 2026* includes Jan–Jul origins and Aug burnoff. No causal claim.
